outcome: Postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) defined as blood loss >=1000 mL
cohort: The study included 271 patients undergoing both vaginal and cesarean deliveries at two quaternary medical centers.
finding: Overall unaided clinician performance in predicting PPH was moderate, with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.64.
mod_finding: Prediction accuracy for PPH was notably higher for cesarean deliveries (AUC 0.82) compared to vaginal deliveries (AUC 0.56).
